metadata.document: Consistency of Fast-track Approvals Bill with Obligations under New Zealand's Free Trade Agreements

cleaned_body_text: The purpose of this memorandum is to consider the implications of the Fast-track Approvals Bill under New Zealand's free trade agreements. Specifically, it considers whether any of the Bill's provisions may be inconsistent with those free trade agreements, procedurally and/or substantively. Our preliminary analysis indicates the Bill is likely to be inconsistent with, or in breach of, general and specific commitments under the New Zealand-United Kingdom, New Zealand-European Union, and CPTPP free trade agreements. This includes best endeavours commitments to provide for a high level of environmental protection, obligations not to weaken or derogate from environmental laws to encourage trade or investment, transparency obligations, and requirements to effectively implement multilateral environmental agreements and the Paris Agreement.
